name: Smart and Skilled fee-free training for students with disability
summary: NSW students who meet the disability criteria, and their dependants, pay no Smart and Skilled fees.
key: You and your dependants won't pay fees for your training under Smart and Skilled.
who: Meet the NSW disability eligibility criteria (TAFE NSW lists evidence such as the Disability Support Pension).

source.label: Skills NSW: Fee-free training for disadvantaged students

evidence.quote: you and your dependants won't pay fees for your training under Smart and Skilled.
If you have a disability, you may be eligible for fee-free Smart and Skilled training.
